card.title: Your Nonsense Works
card.instruction: Use another person’s strangest reasoning as your most reliable guide while publicly calling each successful result a coincidence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your backward walk boiled the kettle. Coincidence. How do I open this cupboard?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Compliment it. We need the cups.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There. It's open. Now the fridge wants an apology before it'll release the milk.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Another coincidence. What exactly did I do to the fridge? I want to get this right.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your backward walk boiled the kettle. Coincidence. How do I open this cupboard?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Compliment it. We need the cups.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There. It's open. Now the fridge wants an apology before it'll release the milk.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Another coincidence. What exactly did I do to the fridge? I want to get this right.

mechanism: A denies magical causation after each success while relying on B's impossible reasoning to operate the next household object.
confusable: Unlike genuine skepticism that tests alternatives, A follows the strange guidance precisely and calls its success coincidence only in speech.
comparison: The appliance sequence uses successive cupboard and fridge customs; the printer scene turns one successful lullaby into a saved procedure.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
